=== wrong password must fail gracefully ===
HTTP 200 (no redirect = good)
Der Login ist fehlgeschlagen
GET / after failed login: HTTP 302 -> http://127.0.0.1:32789/login

observation.command: echo '=== wrong password must fail gracefully ==='; curl -s -c /tmp/c2.txt -o /tmp/bad.html -w 'HTTP %{http_code} (no redirect = good)\n' -d 'login-submit=1&user=4874e97068325d2ec1c29b052bfd3a7f&pass=WrongPass99' http://127.0.0.1:32789/login; grep -oE 'Der Login ist fehlgeschlagen' /tmp/bad.html | head -1; curl -s -b /tmp/c2.txt -o /dev/null -w 'GET / after failed login: HTTP %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n' http://127.0.0.1:32789/
